task: A short square column carries an 80 kN compressive load, and the compressive stress may not exceed 20 MPa. Find the minimum side of the square section, then model the column with that square section and 150 mm tall.

An aluminium busbar (resistivity 2.65e-8 ohm m) 500 mm long must have a resistance of 50 microohm. It is 20 mm wide; find its thickness. Then model the busbar, 500 mm by 20 mm by that thickness, with a 10 mm diameter through hole 15 mm from each end, on the centerline.
A solid brass cylinder (density 8500 kg/m^3) 40 mm in diameter must weigh 0.5 kg. Find its height, then model the cylinder.

A flat square plate faces a 20 m/s airflow (air density 1.225 kg/m^3, drag coefficient 1.2) and must produce 14.7 N of drag. Find the side of the square, then model the plate with that side and 5 mm thick.
A steel rod (thermal expansion coefficient 12e-6 per K) must lengthen by 0.36 mm when heated by 100 K. Find its length, then model the rod as a solid cylinder 10 mm in diameter with that length.

A heater plate must dissipate 120 W at a surface power density of 0.5 W/cm^2. It is 120 mm wide; find its length. Then model the plate, that long, 120 mm wide and 4 mm thick, with a 4 mm diameter through hole 10 mm in from each side at each of the four corners.
A hydraulic piston must produce 20 kN of force at an oil pressure of 10 MPa. Find the piston diameter, then model the piston as a solid cylinder of that diameter and 60 mm long.

Two bolts share a 12 kN shear load equally, and the shear stress in each may not exceed 60 MPa. Find the minimum bolt diameter. Then model a bar 80 mm long, 30 mm wide and 10 mm thick with two through holes of that diameter on the long centerline, 50 mm apart and centered on the bar.

A glider wing with a lift coefficient of 1.0 flies at 15 m/s in air of density 1.225 kg/m^3 and must lift 400 N. Its span is 6 m; find its chord. Then model the wing as a flat plate 6000 mm long, as wide as that chord, and 20 mm thick.
A copper ground strap (resistivity 1.68e-8 ohm m) 1 m long and 2 mm thick must have a resistance of 0.4 milliohm. Find its width, then model the strap, 1000 mm long, that wide and 2 mm thick.
